description: This source file defines a utility enum `WindowPlacement` with static methods for calculating and adjusting window frame positions on macOS screens using AppKit. It includes methods for centering, positioning in the top right, anchoring below other windows, and ensuring windows stay on screen.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame centered within the specified screen, defaulting to the main screen if none is specified.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:on:)
methods.description: Calculates a top-right aligned frame with specified size and padding within a given screen.

methods.name: centeredFrame(size:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame centered within given bounds.

methods.name: topRightFrame(size:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a top-right frame within bounds with padding.

methods.name: anchoredBelowFrame(size:anchor:padding:in:)
methods.description: Calculates a frame positioned below an anchor rectangle, constrained within bounds.

methods.name: ensureOnScreen(window:defaultSize:fallback:)
methods.description: Ensures the window is on-screen by repositioning it if necessary, using fallback positioning if it is off-screen.
